summary: Persistent internal representations (amendment item 3, KF-E04). Before PS every core call passed state=None: no recurrent / persistent latent state (spec 1.3), b depended on the re-encoded window only. PS: nn/persist.py PersistentStateChain carries the core slots across decisions (positions = committed decisions; the state of a position is recomputed from the stored anchor K=2 decisions back with the current weights, so decision-time and replayed beliefs are one function and gradients cross K decision boundaries); CamLiveModel.core_forward resolves state=None through the attached chain; learned per-slot retention rho (0 = the pre-PS computation, set for legacy checkpoints). Agent threading PS-1 applied by ST in dde7d2d.

AM3-audit.claim: the pre-PS design does not satisfy spec 1.3 'recurrent or persistent latent state' nor CAM_LIVE_ARCHITECTURE section 2 (slots carried between calls); spec 2.1 m_t half met (fast posterior not an input of F_theta)

AM3-implementation.evidence: finite differences through K transitions; decision-time = replay to 1e-6; rho=0 / fresh states bit-identical to the pre-PS core (check_bitident.json)

AM3-integration.evidence: agent-level tests pass in the repository; runtime runs: every learner re-encoding resolved to a stored position (rows_fresh 0); test_agent_recovery passes with the chain on

AM3-causal.evidence: within-decision counterfactual: debug TV 0.0079 per decision, relative change of b 0.24; full size in docs/PS.md section 4.4

AM3-improvement.evidence: synthetic memory: out-of-window accuracy 0.29 -> 0.80 (K=2, 3 seeds); fixed-stream replay on LabWorld/codec experience: prequential NLL on-off -0.004 (SE 0.003, 12 pairs), retention no difference, held-out codec -0.021 (9/12); on-line on/off outcomes dominated by trajectory divergence; full size in docs/PS.md section 4.4

AM3-compatibility.evidence: legacy checkpoint -> persist_rho reported missing, rho closed to 0, beliefs bit-identical; live-run checkpoint: docs/PS.md 4.5
